about.sectionHeading: Building Things That Outlast the Deal
about.quote: Real estate execution is not merely about constructing structures; it is about taking ownership, reducing risk through meticulous design, and leaving an enduring legacy of trust.
bioParagraphs: I am a Boutique Real Estate developer with over two decades of experience spanning construction, infrastructure, redevelopment, and commercial real estate projects. I hold a Bachelor's in Civil Engineering from Mumbai University, a Post Graduate Diploma in Construction Management from NICMAR, an MBA in Construction and Finance from Manchester University (UK), and a PMP certification from the USA.

My journey began in Mumbai, coming from a middle-class background where my father served as a Senior Banker at the Reserve Bank of India. Since childhood, reading business magazines instilled a deep ambition to continuously aim higher and embrace challenges. This drive took me from managing live residential projects on-ground in India to co-founding and directing one of Dubai's largest real estate development companies.

Throughout my career, I have been privileged to contribute to landmark developments, managing every stage of the project lifecycle from land acquisition and project finance to customer experience and long-term asset creation.
lifestyleParagraph: Beyond the boardroom and construction sites, I believe in maintaining a strong work-life balance. I run and sprint 10 kilometers every morning to keep my adrenaline high, and I am an active member of the MCA Club in Bandra where I play badminton and squash.
A dedicated family man, I am grounded by spiritual practices, starting my day with meditation to ensure focused decision-making.

journey.title: The Foundation
journey.description: Graduated with a B.E. in Civil Engineering and immediately started as a Site Engineer for a private real estate developer, successfully navigating the intense pressure of delivering residential flats directly to buyers.
highlights: Hands-on site engineering and execution
Direct buyer handovers and site management
Ground-zero exposure to construction realities

journey.title: The Training Ground
journey.description: Relocated to Dubai to serve as Director of a Middle East-headquartered, multidisciplinary real estate and construction conglomerate. Underwent rigorous, hands-on training across contracting, ready-mix concrete, precast, MEP, real estate development, and steel structures, mentored by some of the industry's most experienced professionals within the group.
highlights: Multidisciplinary training in precast & MEP
Direct mentorship under Experienced Professionals
Cross-functional construction exposure

journey.title: Scaling to the Top 5
journey.description: Co-founded the conglomerate’s real estate development arm, establishing it among Dubai’s top five developers within three years. Built a portfolio of 27 projects valued at over $2 billion, spanning 15 million sq. ft. across residential high-rise and commercial towers in prime Dubai locations. Became the first developer in Dubai to launch and deliver a project ahead of schedule in Jumeirah Village South, pioneering an integrated approach to financing, technology, execution, and delivery.
highlights: Scaled portfolio to 27 projects ($2B+ value)
Top-5 developer status in Dubai within 3 years
integrated approach to financing, technology, execution, and delivery

journey.title: Building an Real Estate & Construction  Empire from Scratch In India
journey.description: Returned to India to establish and build the company’s operations. Started with a single small contract and scaled the business to 52+ projects, generating over ₹5,000 crore in revenue with a team of 1,200+ professionals. Successfully delivered projects ahead of schedule to 2,500+ customers, consistently ensuring exceptional quality and timely delivery.
highlights: Scaled operations from 1 contract to 52+ projects.
Generated ₹5,000+ crore in revenue.
Delivered projects ahead of schedule to 2,500+ customers.

journey.title: The Lifestyle Shift
journey.description: Founded Sukoon Stays, pioneering premium luxury student accommodation and co-living in Juhu and Vile Parle.
highlights: Pioneered premium student co-living in Juhu & Vile Parle
Technology-enabled modern student living ecosystems
Expansion into premium co-working spaces

journey.title: The Legacy Phase
journey.description: Leading Nyshaa Realty as Managing Director, driving the company’s growth and strategic direction across boutique redevelopment, commercial, residential, data center, and mixed-use developments in Mumbai. Focused on identifying high-potential opportunities, creating differentiated development strategies, and overseeing projects from acquisition and planning through execution and delivery, with a strong emphasis on quality, innovation, and value creation.
highlights: * Leading Nyshaa Realty’s growth across Mumbai’s real estate landscape.
* Driving boutique redevelopment, residential, commercial, data center, and mixed-use projects.
* Overseeing opportunities from acquisition to execution, delivery, and value creation.

ventures.focus: Leading the strategic vision for premium redevelopment, commercial real estate, and mixed-use developments. We specialize in transforming urban spaces through land acquisition, meticulous design management, and fast execution construction techniques.
ventures.vision: Our goal extends beyond construction; we aim to create destinations that generate long-term value for investors and communities alike.

ventures.focus: A trusted brand in premium student accommodation and luxury co-living across Juhu, Vile Parle, and Andheri. We are now expanding into next-generation co-working spaces in Andheri East and Wagle Estate, Thane, designed to be entrepreneurial ecosystems for start-ups and innovators.
ventures.vision: To provide safe, technology-enabled living and workspace solutions that foster innovation, personal growth, and professional success.
